name: s1-secops-mcp
description: PowerQuery, Management Console API, Unified Alert Management, Singularity Data Lake and Hyperautomation tools for a SentinelOne tenant.
long_description:
Runs the s1-secops-mcp server (stdio) inside Claude Desktop. Enter the console URL and API token in the extension settings; Claude Desktop stores fields marked sensitive in the OS secure store (Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows) and passes them to the server as environment variables at launch. The server is started with S1_KEYCHAIN=off, so the values in these settings are the only credentials it uses.

35 tools: PowerQuery (LRQ) hunts and schema discovery, generic Mgmt Console REST calls, UAM alert triage (status, analyst verdict, assignee, notes), SDL configuration files and dashboards, HEC log ingest, UAM test-alert ingest, and Hyperautomation workflow import and export. Also serves the soc_analyst and session_init prompts.

console_url.title: Console URL
console_url.description: SentinelOne Management Console URL, for example https://usea1-acme.sentinelone.net (no trailing path).

api_token.title: Console API token
api_token.description: Management Console API token (service user or console user). Used for the Mgmt API, UAM, PowerQuery and SDL.

hec_ingest_url.title: HEC ingest URL (optional)
hec_ingest_url.description: HEC ingest host for hec_ingest, uam_ingest_alert and uam_post_alert, for example https://ingest.us1.sentinelone.net.

hec_token.title: SDL Log Write Key (optional)
hec_token.description: SDL Log Write Key, used only by hec_ingest. Console > Singularity Data Lake > API Keys > Log Write Key.

scope.title: Default S1-Scope (optional)
scope.description: Default S1-Scope for SDL requests: "<accountId>" or "<accountId>:<siteId>". Leave blank to use the token default.

output_dir.title: Output directory (optional)
output_dir.description: The only directory tools may write outputFile results to. Leave blank to allow your home directory and the system temp directory.

claude_md_path.title: SOC analyst CLAUDE.md (optional)
claude_md_path.description: CLAUDE.md served by the soc_analyst prompt and the sentinelone://soc-context resource. Leave blank to use the copy bundled with the extension.
